evidence.primary_source: Royal Children's Hospital pediatric acute pain/urticaria/gastroenteritis/asthma/antimicrobial guidance + GINA 2026 + NICE lower-UTI guidance + current SmPC/product labeling + Pediatric Pharmacy Association obesity dosing principles
evidence.note: Expanded diagnosis-specific pediatric outpatient/home medication engine with explicit weight scalar, source maxima, duration, administration/food instructions, contraindication gates, concentration-verified mL/course-volume arithmetic and device/topical/non-mg dose models. Registry now contains 89 regimens across antibiotics, analgesia, antiemetics, antihistamines, asthma controllers/relievers, dermatology, GI/ORS/constipation, antiparasitics, antivirals, ENT/ophthalmology, allergy and migraine. Portugal reconciliation is documented separately; Azores real-time stock is not asserted. Yellow pending human pediatric/pharmacy review and Portuguese INFOMED/RCM product reconciliation. Azores stock is not a release gate. A central STOP/ALERT/CAUTION/INFO medication safety alert engine is integrated for allergies, class cross-reactivity, duplicate therapy, selected major interactions, organ-function gates, age/weight/product mismatches and global outpatient red flags. 89/89 regimens received an AI-assisted pediatric clinical audit focused on indication, source-age scope, discharge suitability, red flags and escalation; 40 entries required clinical gate/source-scope correction and no CHANGE_REQUIRED remains unresolved. This is not human pediatrician sign-off.
